The Department of Health and Social Care says more than 10 million flu vaccinations have been delivered in England since bookings first opened in August and vaccinations began in September.
This includes 2.7 million vaccinations in that week.
The government is running a social media campaign on Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat and, for the first time, TikTok.
It is also promoting an NHS App feature that lets people check their eligibility and book a flu jab at a community pharmacy.
